mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger activates but SPX posts positive 20-day returns > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE trigger activates but SPX posts positive 5-day returns > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline month-over-month for two consecutive periods, it signals a broad weakening in consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline MoM for 2 periods
failure_condition: Interaction trigger activates but SPX posts positive 20-day returns > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) of more than 2% over 3 months signals a spike in inflation that will pressure the Fed to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL trigger activates but SPX posts positive 60-day returns > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines month-over-month for three consecutive periods, it signals a significant weakening in the labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS trigger activates but SPX posts positive 20-day returns > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) both show year-over-year growth above 3% for two consecutive quarters, it signals a strong and broadening economic expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both have YoY growth > 3% for 2 quarters
failure_condition: Interaction trigger activates but SPX posts negative 60-day returns > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy stance that will pressure S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS trigger activates but SPX posts positive 20-day returns > 60% of the time.
